questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: First of all, the culture was important for my choice of destination. Second, I also wanted to choose a city, in which I hadn't previously explored, but still an easy city to understand etc. The country was also important, as I wanted to be able to go on shorter trips within the country, so that it had good infrastructure etc. was a point, that made me choose Portugal. Finally, the great reputation of Nova SBE also contributed to my decision.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Very easy. KU and Nova SBE had a great mobility team helping with everything

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I did not receive any, and didn't want any

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It was easy, as there are several platforms. However, my initial accommodation got cancelled last minute before arrival, but there were several other opportunities

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: You can choose to live in the city center of Lisbon or at Carcavelos near the campus. It was my overall impression that most students appreciated to live in Lisbon city.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: It was a bidding system which was really difficult to understand at the beginning. But at second quarter it was more easy. However, it made it difficult with he pre-approval of courses, because I only knew which courses I actually could get halfway through the semester.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: They provided videos etc. and the mobility team was very helpful

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I ended up with all my preferred courses

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Using the bidding system, you should bid on several more courses than you want to attend, because it is possible that you won't get the once you want the most.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: It was quite low compared to KU, but nice to discover some other courses than I would have chosen in Copenhagen

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It was pretty much the same, however a lot more of group work than what I was used to.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Innovation and Value Creation Wheel, Macroeconomics of Financial Markets, Strategy, Data Curation, Corporate Governance and Sustainable Finance.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Especially Strategy was  fruitful course
